summary.text: Toni Rose is a Democratic state representative from Texas who has represented District 110 since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Toni Rose assumed office in the Texas House in 2013.
In 2023 and 2024 she was assigned to the Human Services Committee (as vice chair), the Appropriations Committee, the Calendars Committee (as vice chair) and the Redistricting Committee.
